name: Gabapentin
executiveSummary: Antiepileptic / neuropathic pain agent. Adult: start **300 mg at night** → **300 mg q8h** (range **900–1800 mg/day**; usual max **3600 mg**). Mandatory renal adjustment. Less potent than pregabalin mg-for-mg; sedation and dizziness.
indications:
## Indications

- Adjunct partial epilepsy; postherpetic neuralgia; neuropathic pain (broad use); restless legs (off-label/labels).

## Precautions

- Adjust by CrCl (reduce dose/interval).
- Do not stop abruptly in epilepsy.
- Abuse potential (with opioids ↑ respiratory depression).

> Saturable absorption — high doses split q8h.

adulto.dose: Pain: day 1 **300 mg**, day 2 **300 mg q12h**, day 3 **300 mg q8h**; titrate to **1800 mg/day** (up to **3600**). Epilepsy: similar titration. CKD: e.g. CrCl <30 → **100–300 mg/day** or every other day per table.

pediatrico.dose: Epilepsy ≥3–12 y: start **10–15 mg/kg/day** → up to **25–40 mg/kg/day** divided q8h — neurology.

adverseEffects:
## Adverse effects

Somnolence, dizziness, ataxia, edema, fatigue; rare: hypersensitivity, suicidal ideation.

bibliography.citation: FDA. Gabapentin — respiratory depression with opioids.
